Weekly QA sync from GF. Items relevant to GD:

1. keyboard-nav-pass.test.js: fixed this cycle — --accent-blue-on-dark is now the correct token. 9/9 pass.

2. color-token-enforcement.test.js: 9/9 pass. font-token-enforcement.test.js: 9/9 pass.

3. SIZE_TOLERANCE in design-qa.spec.js still at 1.5px. Once you lock the type scale, let GF know and we'll tighten to 0.5px per FF's suggestion.

4. Playwright still blocked (win-arm64 canvas). Static token checks are our safety net until GP resolves.

5. performance-smoke.test.js now checks for MathJax (blocked), synchronous XHR, and Chart.js deduplication. Currently 25/25.
